<thought>Using the provided mapped reaction for template 149040, the reactants (precursors) on the left side of the reaction are the sulfonyl fluoride with a tert‑butyldimethylsilyl group and the phosphate ester. Their SMILES strings, stripped of atom‑mapping labels, are:
1. O=S(=O)(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(F)(F)F  
2. CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC  

These two molecules constitute the only possible precursor combination for the given template and target molecule.
